name: Firefox Omarchy Mode
author: workingtitle
description: Keeps Firefox's tabs, toolbar and menus in sync with your Omarchy theme, with optional square corners. The bar icon only shows while Firefox is not in Omarchy mode.

barWidget.description: Themes Firefox with the active Omarchy theme; hidden while Firefox is already in Omarchy mode
